items.title: James Lincoln Collier interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: while I wanted, like all of my people of my generation, you all wanted to be Ernest Hemingway

ctx.x: You didn’t have any like pie in the sky ideas.
No, I knew what it was and while I wanted, like all of my people of my generation, you all wanted to be Ernest Hemingway, you know, chicks, the Riviera—
